notes: BUB1B compound heterozygous -> Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy syndrome type 1 (MVA1, MIM 257300). Allele A: c.2210T>G p.(Leu737Ter), nonsense in exon 17, ClinVar Pathogenic (VCV000533901, rs759242053), gnomAD AF 8e-5. Allele B: c.3006T>G p.(Asn1002Lys), missense in exon 23 (kinase domain), absent from gnomAD, SIFT deleterious / PolyPhen 0.997 / AlphaMissense 0.923. Phenotype (rhabdomyosarcoma HP:0002859, severe IUGR, nephrocalcinosis, muscle atrophy, parental recurrent miscarriage) matches MVA1. Phase not experimentally confirmed (variants 10.9kb apart, no trio); compound-het inferred (no ROH/consanguinity).
